items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, we played the Apollo. ... Actually, they say after working with Ella Fitzgerald you played with Frankie Newton. ... Before Lips Page you were with Frankie Newton at Cafe Society downtown. Right.

ctx.x: Well, he had a lot. He had Flip Phillips.
That's the one. Before Flip Phillips, his name was Filipippo(?). He played clarinet with Frankie.
No, Flip never played anything but tenor.
